name: zones_t29_middle_row
description: Conformance test 29 (middle row, §7.6.1): o0 = 10, row step +2 (low-side Q, lot width 2). The number of row positions that satisfy the keep condition fixes mid := o0 + (floor(n/2) - 1) * so when floor(n/2) >= 1, else o0. Row range 10..15 -> n = 3 -> mid 10; 10..17 -> n = 4 -> mid 12; 10..21 -> n = 6 -> mid 14; 10..11 -> n = 1 -> mid 10. In test 20 the forced cross street therefore follows the first row.
